comments.body: I'm not sure I get what this issue is about. Is that the ability to use "Next" and "Previous" strings instead of ">" and "<"?
> I'm not sure I get what this issue is about. Is that the ability to use "Next" and "Previous" strings instead of ">" and "<"? Yes, or even more complex like: ` Next`

This should be handled by some custom templates, but we need to find a way to define several templates for one element. Maybe the `template` key for this widget could be an object like this: ``` javascript { first: '', previous: '...', page: '{{page}}', next: '...', last: '...' } ```
I think I already allowed html in pagination widget :)

I meant, you can already provide html code for labels so we can close this one.

Proof: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/3cc80f565dec97d5f4ecd6f7f8bcdfbebfd6c1ac/components/Pagination/PaginationLink/index.js#L26
